data.one_liner: Ordered Set that keeps elements sorted and allows duplicates by priority.
data.what_it_does: It stores items in order according to a comparator or a mapper function, permitting multiple items with the same priority. The set implements Iterable, so you can iterate in order with O(n) complexity.
use_when: You need a sorted collection that accepts duplicate priorities
You want fast iteration over ordered elements
You need to query subsets by type or cache query results
avoid_when: You only need a unique sorted set—use Dart's SplayTreeSet instead
You require persistence or async operations
weaknesses: No built‑in persistence or async support
Not a full data‑structure library (no tree traversal APIs)
